project.audio: required local audio UUID; complete synchronized clip required

scene.title: editable heading, up to 60 chars
scene.labels: up to six labels; labels are used by the specific diagram only, not a global replacement for every diagram caption
scene.beats: monotonic absolute seconds inside scene; deterministic progress, not CSS wall-clock animations

mediaPolicy.AI: off for this production; reusable optional asset capability remains separate

limitations: 白色主题、竖屏为本次正式验收范围
更换主题内容需重新编排图解内文与声音锚点；并非输入任意音频即可无校对导出
部分思维模型图解有专用语义内文；通用标题与labels不会自动改写全部图解

motion.carryText: hidden; geometry only, no double copy

presenterOverlay.geometry: 1080x1920 coordinates; square source crop; adjustable x/y/size/border/shadow

renderPipeline.cacheScope: within export task; exact SVG state including font/layout implementation; browser animations/media reject reuse

publicProductionRule: 发行版新题材仅使用以上参数化图解；其余为历史兼容，不作为默认新片版式
